scope: Static stable single-hand grasp taxonomy. Not all hand functions. No physical grasp success is inferred from an angle pose.
status: All33 names are coverage obligations, not executed object tests in FUNCTION003. Object dimensions below are robot engineering examples, not paper-derived measurements.

types.name: Medium Wrap
types.contact_goal: palm and multiple fingers opposed to thumb

types.name: Prismatic 4 Finger
types.contact_goal: four finger pads opposed to thumb, distinguish palm contact

types.name: Prismatic 3 Finger
types.contact_goal: three finger pads opposed to thumb

types.name: Prismatic 2 Finger
types.contact_goal: two finger pads opposed to thumb

types.name: Power Disk
types.contact_goal: palm and fingers power disk contact

types.name: Fixed Hook
types.contact_goal: stable taxonomy fixed-hook configuration; separate from gravity-only hook

types.name: Lateral
types.contact_goal: thumb pad against index lateral surface

types.name: Distal Type
types.contact_goal: distal contact arrangement from taxonomy; needs explicit landmark mapping

types.name: Tripod Variation
types.contact_goal: variation from taxonomy, not same joint-pose label as tripod

types.name: Adduction Grip
types.contact_goal: between adjacent digit sides, no thumb opposition

types.name: Lateral Tripod
types.contact_goal: lateral tripod contact distinct from key pinch

types.name: Palmar
types.contact_goal: palm/finger contact with thumb out of way

types.name: Ventral
types.contact_goal: ventral contact arrangement, explicit targets pending

types.name: Inferior Pincer
types.contact_goal: inferior-pincer arrangement distinct from pad/pulp pinch

beyond_taxonomy: both crossing directions and close crossing
